headline: Wardens Recover Ground in Weathered Expanse; Nevish Line Turns
war_summary: Since the previous edition the Warden lines have thickened in the north-west. Weathered Expanse, reported at five Colonial works, one Warden and three unclaimed, now reads five Colonial, two Warden and two unclaimed; fifty-four actions were logged there in the past day, four of them inside two hours, the latest at 11:51. Marban Hollow has gone further the Warden way, now four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed, with Checkpoint Bua the storm centre of thirty-nine actions. The Nevish Line, lately reported level at four works apiece, now stands seven Warden to one Colonial after forty-three actions, six within two hours, Princefal and Grief Mother the busiest. Kuura Strand holds at four Colonial and two Warden but remains the liveliest small front, thirty-three actions about Faden Point. Linn Mercy's works are unchanged at nine Colonial, one Warden and one unclaimed, though its fire has quickened again to twenty-nine Colonial and eighty-four Warden casualties in the last hour. The great casualty rolls of Callahan's Passage and the Dead Lands continue without any change of colours, while Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle remain costly but nearly still.
